verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy is a fair axis for an API product like Financial Connections, but nothing in the evidence pack documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. The llms.txt note about checking npm for the latest package version concerns SDK package versions, not API versioning, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
